project_type: Monorepo: FastAPI Python backend (Azure Container Apps), Cloudflare Worker edge proxy (TypeScript), Vite React frontend
build_system: pnpm workspaces for Node, pip + Docker for Python backend. Root commands: pnpm build:edge, pnpm build:frontend. Backend: docker build via Dockerfile
build_command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build:client
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install, 2. Run edge typecheck (pnpm --filter syrabit-edge run build), 3. Run frontend build (pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit run build:client), 4. Run vitest for edge and frontend, 5. Run pytest for backend (APP_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long-for-ci)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access. Node 22, Python 3.11, pnpm available. No Azure/Cloudflare credentials for live testing - use static analysis and unit tests.
contribution_requirements: pnpm@10.26.1, Node 22+, Python 3.11+. TypeScript strict in edge worker. Frontend uses vite + react.
key_patterns: Singleton httpx.AsyncClient per AI provider with connection pools. Circuit breaker pattern for external services. Upstash Redis via HTTP REST API (not TCP). Beanie ODM for MongoDB. Fire-and-forget tasks for persistence. SSE streaming for chat. lucide-react for icons (v1.16.0 - Github icon does not exist, must use GithubIcon alias).
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/backend (FastAPI + Dockerfile), apps/edge (Cloudflare Worker), apps/frontend (Vite React SPA). infra/ for Azure Bicep. .github/workflows/ for CI/CD.
